scene.ofreeRecent: A brightly fluorescent modern indoor skating rink concession counter — She buys a small cup of shaved ice after her first lap in years and waits as the color settles across it; terraced tea fields on a misty Sichuan hillside — lying on her front; the deck of a tall wooden sailing ship at sea — standing; her living room with a deep sofa — tears a finished page out of a notebook; a starship galley and mess hall — pours tea from a small teapot into a cup on the table; a present-day museum gallery of Three Kingdoms relics — holds a bound bundle of bamboo slips against her chest; a medieval tavern — seated on a chair; A modern apartment reading nook at night — She reaches for the little prism at the end of a chapter and splashes a rectangle of lamplight across the wall; the top of a restored ancient city wall — pushes a red oil-paper umbrella open in front of her; a castle courtyard rose garden around a stone fountain — lying on her front; her bedroom — sitting on the ground; the grand staircase of an old castle — hangs a small hand lantern on a hook above her; an underground subway platform — standing

Place: The small costume mending room of a timber river theater, with drawers for ribbon spools and a fitting mirror.
Activity: Before the spring river pageant she takes a measurement at the elbow to size a removable cuff. As her arm bends, the petal-shaped upper sleeve rotates at its hinge and reveals the outside of her upper arm.
Pose: She stands in a relaxed three-quarter view with her left elbow bent. Her right hand holds one end of the measuring tape beside the left elbow and the left hand rests loosely near the waist.
Framing: A chest-height medium portrait in warm practical light with her face, both hands and the end of the tape clearly visible.
Outfit: A lingerie-inspired costume with a fully lined aubergine satin bodice with scalloped structural seams, matching securely covered tap shorts, and narrow separate petal sleeves on a decorative hinge.
